entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-09-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [wasm][coreclr][R2R] TensorPrimitives.IndexOfMax<double> remains interpreted and ~18x slower #134559
  • [Design] RISC-V: NativeAOT soft-float target (`riscv64-lp64`) and builds without the `A` extension #134558
  • IPNetwork.Contains reports IPv4-mapped 0.x.x.x addresses as inside unrelated IPv6 networks #134557
  • The trace did not contain an AllocationSampled event #134556
  • `TypeDelegator` doesn't forward `GetRequiredCustomModifiers` / `GetOptionalCustomModifiers` #134552
  • Single-file host stack overflow under Wine when DOTNET_BUNDLE_EXTRACT_BASE_DIR is a Linux path #134551
  • [blazor-wasm] A cached empty or error response for a boot resource is reused forever (`force-cache`); the app never boots again, even after a hard reload #134550
  • ARM64: seed an expensive 64-bit constant with a bitmask-immediate MOV plus one MOVK #134546
  • JIT: (Perf) `(x & ~0xFF) == 0` is not used to prove `x < 256` for bounds checks #134545
    Future
  • JIT: (Perf) constant-offset `Slice` is not folded into the load/store addressing mode #134544
    Future
  • JIT: (Perf) loops over two shrinking spans keep 4 IVs (ptr+len per span) instead of comparing pointers #134543
    Future
  • Call WldpCanExecuteBuffer when loading in-memory assemblies on Windows #134542
    12.0.0
  • JIT: LSRA never reuses an enregistered 256/512-bit vector constant on windows-x64, even in call-free code #134540
  • JIT: a method whose only P/Invokes are `[SuppressGCTransition]` still forces an RBP frame that nothing uses (win-x64) #134539
  • ARM64: elide `mov Wd, Wd` when the preceding 32-bit ALU instruction already zeroed bits 63:32 #134538
  • JIT: [ARM64] strength-reduce `x * (2^k + 1)` to a single shifted `ADD` #134537
  • [API Proposal]: Add `IOException.Path`/`FileName` #134536
  • [browser] Wasm.Build.Tests BuildThenPublishWithAOT (Chrome) times out due to ChromeDriver port-binding race (Connection refused) #134534
  • [API Proposal]: Add `DirectoryNotEmptyException` and `FileAlreadyExistsException` #134532
  • System.Security.Cryptography.Tests.HpkeImplementationTests.InvalidEncapsulation_Rejected fails in CI #134528
    11.0.0
  • Evaluate cache-only URL retrieval by default during Windows TLS credential acquisition #134525
    Future
  • Double mapper is created at a clipped size that cannot be used (RLIMIT_FSIZE), so the existing W^X fallback never runs #134524
  • Stack trace line numbers wrong after tier-1. Possible related to PGO/GDV #134523
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner — Feedback failed #134519
  • [aw] CI Outer-Loop Failure Scanner failed #134513
  • [Android] mono-aot-cross.exe crashes with STATUS_HEAP_CORRUPTION (0xC0000374) in emit phase while AOT-compiling one assembly for Android #134510
  • Android: Trust anchor for certification path not found, When using custom CA #134504
  • Stored ZIP entries can report successful completion despite truncated data #134496
  • Request backport of XmlReader malformed UTF-8 fix (#124428) to release/8.0 and release/10.0 #134495
  • [ci-scan] Test failure: JIT/opt/GuardedDevirtualization/badinlinee/badinlinee.cmd exits with -1 on windows arm64 Composite gcstr [Content truncated due to length] #134493
  • [Dotnet10][SVR::gc_heap] - DATAS ignores msl lock wait times and check_heap_count continuously deferred by BGC leading to high sustained msl contention on single SVR::gc_heap #134492
    12.0.0
  • .NET 11 breaks named Mutex interop with every earlier .NET on Linux and macOS #134491
  • JIT: (bug) bounds check wrongly removed under a data race (liberal VN reused as conservative VN for LCL_FLD of struct phi) #134489
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) exponential compile time in `ValueNumStore::IsVectorPerElementMask` #134487
    12.0.0

Closed

  • Libs: (bug) string.Join assumes the input is immutable #134515
  • JIT: (bug) VN ignores HWIntrinsic auxiliary type, so `Avx2.GatherVector128` with int and long indices is treated as equal #134486
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `Vector128.Create((int)Vector128.Dot(shortVec, shortVec))` returns the Dot result broadcast as shorts #134479
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) `Vector128.Equals(Avx.Compare(a, b, UnorderedEqual*/OrderedNotEqual*), Zero)` produces bad IR on AVX-512 (assert / wrong result / illegal instruction) #134480
    12.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: Add Random parameter to Enumerable.Shuffle #134438
  • [ci-scan] Build break: SYSLIB1064 in AppleTestRunner.cs blocks Apple NativeAOT test legs #134061
    12.0.0
  • [Android] SslStreamTls11NetworkConformanceTests fail with 'SslProtocols (Tls11) are not supported on this platform' despite ConditionalClass(SupportsTls11) skip #133998
    Future
  • [ci-scan] Build break: CS9377/CS9389 memory-safety errors in monodroid-nativeaot.cs block Android NativeAOT legs #134115
  • [ci-scan] Interpreter assert SetInterpreterCode: m_interpreterCode != INTERPRETER_CODE_POISON (method.hpp:1992) crashes test hos [Content truncated due to length] #133771
    12.0.0
  • [QUIC] [Windows] QuicConnection ConnectAsync leaks on timeout #134161
    12.0.0
  • CI failure on Windows: Connection aborted in SocketsHttpHandler_HttpClientHandlerTest.SendAsync_RequestWithLatin1HeaderValue_Succeeds #132004
    12.0.0
  • JIT: (bug) NativeAOT: variable-offset load from preinitialized `static readonly` struct folded as offset 0 #134488
    12.0.0
